anna: kicking off pilot scoping with BridgeBank — they want a 4-week pilot to prove embeddings + rerank for internal document search, plus a tool-calling flow to surface live account balances. can we align on success criteria and red flags?
michael: timeline sounds tight but doable. quick clarifying q: target p95/p50 latency for search + rerank? and expected qps during pilot?
rico: for the initial eval they said ~10 qps peak, mostly synchronous user searches. target p50 <200ms, p95 <600ms would be ideal. if we need lower we can propose a dedicated capacity quote.
anna: perfect. on accuracy they want >85% relevant results on their 200-query eval set. they'll provide queries + ground truth.
sasha: security notes — BridgeBank requires KMS integration for keys, SOC2 audit, and an inbound security questionnaire (SaaS + dedicated deployment options). we should flag on-prem as a potential blocker if SME data needs to stay in their VPC.
michael: model questions: they asked about context length (documents are long), tool calling safety, and whether embeddings+ranks can be done without exposing raw documents. propose: use chunked embeddings (4k windows) + reranker model with local KV to avoid sending full docs to the generator for rerank stage.
rico: suggested stack: embeddings via redwood-embed-4k, vector index (faiss on dedicated infra), lightweight reranker (redwood-rank) for top-10, then optional tool call only after rerank. keeps generator calls minimal.
anna: can you put that in a short runbook we can share with the customer? also include pricing options: hosted usage vs 1-month reserved capacity trial.
michael: I'll draft pricing: hosted = per-embedding + per-rerank-token; reserved (monthly commit) to hit their latency SLOs — include burst option. will add a simple cost example for 10 qps, 20k docs.
sasha: regarding the security questionnaire, ask them for answers to these 3 baseline items: data residency requirement, threat model for tool calls, and encryption key ownership. if they insist on customer-managed keys we route to Private (VPC).
rico: also: eval plan — 1) ingest 20k docs, 2) run embedding baseline, 3) create 200-query eval harness, 4) compute nDCG/MRR and human A/B for top-3. success = nDCG increase >20% vs their current system AND human pass rate >=85%.
anna: nice. BridgeBank finance team will also want a proof-of-cost breakdown (est. tokens/calls). can we get a simple worksheet?
michael: attaching sample prompt and reranker snippet to speed their eval: 
```
# user search prompt (for reranker)
Context: <<DOCUMENT_SNIPPETS>>
User: "Show me account opening steps for small business loans"
Instruction: "Rank the following snippets by relevance and factuality to the user query. Return top 3 with short rationale."
```

anna: BridgeBank asked if tool calling supports auth to their internal API via short-lived creds. rico, is that supported in Private/Dedicated?
rico: yes — Private supports customer-managed auth and short-lived STS tokens. Hosted can do proxying with an allowlist but not direct vault integration. mark as constraint.
sasha: also add an acceptance criterion: no PII must be logged to hosted endpoints during pilot. redact at ingest and confirm retention policy. put that in the SOW.
anna: next steps: michael to send pricing + worksheet by EOD tomorrow; rico to draft runbook + reranker flow; sasha to prepare security questionnaire checklist and identify any blockers for Private deployment. i'll schedule a 30-min sync with BridgeBank for Friday. :calendar: :thumbsup:
michael: ack — will share numbers.
rico: working on runbook now.
sasha: will compile checklist and flags.
security-bot: reminder — attach latest SOC2 report and KMS integration doc when responding to security questions.
anna: thanks team — we'll aim to have a public-facing one-pager and a technical appendix for the POC. will post the docs here when ready.
